entries.title: INSIDERS: Activities at the Village Square Branch
entries.description: Join us for socializing, finding new friends, networking, making jokes, learn to play Dungeons Dragons, and having fun with art!

entries.title: Family Storytime
entries.description: Storytime is designed to accommodate a mix of ages and invites the entire family to participate in early literacy activities such as stories, songs, rhymes, fingerplays, and movement activities.

entries.title: Family Storytime
entries.description: Storytime is designed to accommodate a mix of ages and invites the entire family to participate in early literacy activities such as stories, songs, rhymes, fingerplays, and movement activities.

entries.title: Infant and Toddler Storytime
entries.description: Infant and Toddler Storytime invites children and their caregivers to wiggle, rhyme, and sing with diverse books, songs, and fingerplays that encourage language, play, and exploration. \nThis program is geared for children 0 to 3 years of age and their parents/caregivers, but all children are welcome!

entries.title: Toddler Storytime: Stories and Songs for 12-36 Month Olds
entries.description: This story time features lots of movement, singing, and action.

entries.title: Baby Lapsit Storytime and Stay & Play
entries.description: nbsp;Baby Lapsit invites newborns, infants, babies, and their caregivers to learn together and strengthen their relationship with each other through stories, songs, bounces, tickles, rhymes, books, and play.After storytime concludes, we invite you to Stay Play.

entries.title: Bilingual Family Storytime/ Hora de Cuentos & Stay and Play
entries.description: Bilingual Family storytime is geared for a mix of ages and invites the entire family to participate in early literacy activities such as stories, rhymes, fingerplays, and movement activities.nbsp;After Storytime concludes, families are invited to Stay Play!

entries.title: Family Storytime
entries.description: Storytime is a fun and interactive experience designed to accommodate a mix of ages and invites the entire family to participate in early literacy activities such as stories, songs, rhymes, fingerplays, and movement activities.nbsp; This program promotes the joys of reading and learning for children of all ages and their parents/caregivers!

entries.title: Indoor Family Storytime
entries.description: Family storytime is designed to accommodate a mix of ages and invites the entire family to participate in early literacy activities such as stories, songs, rhymes, fingerplays, and movement activities.

entries.title: Reading to Children in Japanese にほんご　おはなし会
entries.description: Preschool age children and their parents/caregivers are invited to the West Valley Branch Library for Reading to Children in Japanese.

entries.title: Reading to Children
entries.description: Participating in the Reading to Children program is a great way for children to develop their imagination and spark a love for books, reading, and learning.

entries.title: Rose Garden Game Lounge
entries.description: Come relax and have fun with our twice-monthly after-school game lounge!

entries.title: Chess Club for Kids
entries.description: Come learn to play chess, or just play a game!

entries.title: LEGO® Fun
entries.description: Bring your creativity and imagination to build unique models using our LEGO® pieces. \nImportant: Children under 5 must be accompanied by their parents as small LEGO® pieces can be choking hazards.\nFor children and families.

entries.title: Sanskrit for Beginners
entries.description: This beginner course will introduce Sanskrit to children.nbsp; Students will begin by learning the alphabet.\nFor Ages 7-17.

entries.title: Thanksgiving Celebration
entries.description: Join us for a fun-filled afternoon at the Village Square Branch Library with arts, crafts, snacks, and prizes to celebrate Thanksgiving!

entries.title: College Readiness
entries.description: These in-person sessions can help strengthen your knowledge, goals, letter writing,nbsp;and\n test-taking skills to improve your college application and set you up for future success!

entries.title: Create Green Screen Clips
entries.description: Play with green screen effects andnbsp;create your own personalized clips using the iMovie app on the iPad and a full-sized Green screen.nbsp;Props and materials will be providednbsp;to make your clip come to life.Recommended for ages 10-18.nbsp;Free.

entries.title: Cricut Open Lab
entries.description: You can also watch these tutorial videos ahead of time to get a better idea of how to use the Cricut machine and Design Space.nbsp;For those who already have experience using Cricut, they are welcome to register tonbsp;use a machine independently to cut out their designs.

entries.title: Friday Fun - Sunflower Fan
entries.description: Join us this Friday for a fun and interactive craft!

entries.title: Friday Fun : Board Games!
entries.description: This week --nbsp;Like to play games with other kids?

entries.title: Friday Fun: Christmas Paper Ornaments
entries.description: This week, we'll make colorful and festive paper ornaments to celebrate the winter holidays.

entries.title: Henna with Rachel-Anne Palacios
entries.description: Learn about this traditional body art, and how to apply henna to yourself.

entries.title: STEAM Club
entries.description: Each week,nbsp;participants will experience an exciting, new STEAM adventure involvingnbsp;hands-on activities that integrate different aspects of STEAM and showcase how STEAM concepts are appliednbsp;in the real worldnbsp;(a list of session topics may be found here).

entries.title: The GreenRoots Collective: Environmental Technology Workshops
entries.description: Each workshop introduces a scientific idea, gives students the opportunity to investigate it through a hands-on activity, and challenges them to apply what they learn to a practical solution.

entries.title: Vietnamese Storytime & Craft / Kể chuyện và làm thủ công bằng tiếng Việt
entries.description: Children and their parents or caregivers will enjoy stories, songs, and playful activities in Vietnamesenbsp;that help build early language and literacy skills.Following thenbsp;Storytime, kids will learn to make a simple and creative craft to take home!

entries.title: Friends of the East San Jose Carnegie Library Book Sale
entries.description: Come support your local library branch and find new literary treasures for yourself!

entries.title: LEGO SPIKE Robots!
entries.description: nbsp; Participants will follow simple step-by-stepnbsp;picture instructions on a tablet to build an exciting frog, dog, or other kind of robot, and then learn to usenbsp;simple Word Blocks to make their robot perform their commands!

entries.title: Community Yoga & Meditation
entries.description: Learn basic Yoga routines, develop flexibility, relaxation and better health!

entries.title: Cambrian Branch Library's 20th Anniversary
entries.description:
Cambrian Branch is home to Cambrian Beeline, a public artwork featuring stainless steel panels with glass and bronze sculptures inspired by the area’s orchards, local history, and themes of exploration and discovery.nbsp;Stop by and check it out during your next visit.
Special Thanks
This event has been generously sponsorednbsp;andnbsp;made possible by Friends of Cambrian Library.

entries.title: Family Movie Night at the Library
entries.description: We are watching 1996's Matilda.

entries.title: Mind Floating: An Art Exhibit
entries.description: Looking back, I can see changes in the way I draw and the things I notice, alongside familiar themes I continue to return to.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 回顾过去，我能看到自己的绘画方式和关注的事物发生了变化，也看到自己持续回归的一些熟悉主题。照片由艺术家提供。

entries.title: LEGO Club
entries.description: Students in Kindergarten to 8th grade are welcome to play and create with LEGOs on the first Tuesday of each month.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 欢迎幼儿园至 8 年级学生在每月第一个星期二使用 LEGO 积木玩耍和创作。

entries.title: Reading Buddies [Compañeros de Lectura]
entries.description: Come practice your reading skills and read aloud one on one with a furry friend!
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 每次 15 分钟的阅读活动由一只受过专门训练的治疗犬及其志愿者陪同。Gilroy 图书馆的 Reading Buddies 活动从九月开始，在每月第 1 个星期二举行。

entries.title: Knit & Crochet Circle @ Saratoga Library
entries.description: Bring your own projects and yarn, ask questions, receive help, give help, share ideas, and meet new people!
entries.priorTitleZh: Saratoga 图书馆编织与钩针交流圈
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 带上自己的作品和毛线，提出问题、互相帮助、分享想法并认识新朋友。

entries.title: Friends of the Milpitas Library Big Winter Book Sale
entries.description: Amazon Sales We have a large catalog of books for sale on Amazon, and we try to offer the lowest price for every title that we list.
entries.priorTitleZh: Milpitas 图书馆之友冬季大型书展
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 每周日所有图书均享 50% 折扣。另有 Amazon 图书销售，提供大量线上在售图书，并尽力为每个书目提供最低价格。

entries.title: Little Explorers: Wonderful Winter!
entries.description: We may not have snow, but we can still play in a wintery way, with a variety of snowy-themed crafts and play activities.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 即使没有下雪，也能通过冰雪主题手工和游戏感受冬季。Little Explorers 是面向幼儿及学龄前儿童家庭的每月创意活动。欢迎每月第一个星期五来探索新的玩耍和学习方式。

entries.title: Kids Keva Club for ages 5 and up
entries.description: Lego lovers will enjoy the freedom to build.
entries.priorTitleZh: 5 岁及以上儿童 KEVA 搭建俱乐部
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 只用木板，不用工具、胶水、钉子或胶带，练习艺术创作和建筑设计技能。

entries.title: Saturday Board Games Day
entries.description: Attendees can bring their own games to play or jump-in with others.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 小组每月第 1 个周六上午 10 点至下午 6 点聚会。参与者可以自带游戏，也可以加入其他人的游戏。

entries.title: Baby Sign and Stay and Play
entries.description: Enjoy this socialization for babies and their grownups. 10:30-11:00am Storytime 11:00-12:00pm Stay & Play Thank you to the Los Altos Friends of the Library for making this program possible.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 面向 0–12 个月、尚未学会走路的宝宝，开展包含美国手语、歌曲和故事的特别故事时间。
